questions.q: Tap a spot where our forward cannot be called offside.
options: Past the far line, on the left
Between halfway and the far line
Past the far line, on the right
questions.explain: Right. Between halfway and the far line, offside cannot apply.
choiceExplanations: Past the far line and ahead of the defenders, this spot is offside.
Right. Between halfway and the far line, offside cannot apply.
This spot is past the far line and ahead of the defenders, so offside.

questions.q: Put these moments in order, first to last.
options: Forward stays short of the far line
Forward runs past the far line
Forward comes back before the pass
questions.explain: Yes. First the forward waits short of the line, where offside cannot apply.
choiceExplanations: Yes. First the forward waits short of the line, where offside cannot apply.
The pass comes after the forward finds that safe area.
The forward runs past the line after the ball comes back.
Coming back is last, just before the next pass.

questions.q: Our right midfielder went past the far line. Where should they go?
options: Across the middle, still past the line
Back, short of the far line
questions.explain: Right. Short of the far line, offside cannot apply, so the pass is safe.
choiceExplanations: Farther ahead is still offside, so the pass cannot go there.
Moving across keeps them past the line, so they are still offside.
Right. Short of the far line, offside cannot apply, so the pass is safe.
